description:
Repro (scratch s75e/seq1000.fz, spike binary with FZ_SPIKE_BUDGET raised, base develop ff4a75ada): def f(x), do: x + 1; main binds a1 = f(1) ... a1000 = f(1000) and prints their sum. interp prints 501500. fz2 run panics: cranelift-jit-0.131.3 src/compiled_blob.rs:225 'called Result::unwrap() on an Err value: TryFromIntError(NegOverflow)' (a relocation whose displacement does not fit). Not investigated: which relocation kind, and whether code size or the distance between blobs is the cause. build not tried. Without the raised budget the compile stops earlier at the 50,000-request product budget (the drive needs 1,009,384 requests), so this is reachable only once fz-75e moves the limit. Same program family as fz-d7w (one resume function per call, captures growing by one each step).
Proposal page (awaiting the user's answer): /Users/j5n/Workspace/long-body-step-cost.html — one cause for fz-d7w, fz-2un and fz-75e: each resume step holds a flat copy of every live value.
title: fz2 run panics in the JIT's relocation on a body of 1,000 sequential calls
